name: NASCON
source: CRON 20261013: Unaudited results for the half year ended 30 June 2026: revenue N81.16 billion; cost of sales N40.35 billion; gross profit N40.81 billion; operating profit N24.53 billion; finance income N5.35 billion less finance cost N171.61 million; profit before tax N29.70 billion; income tax N10.10 billion; profit after tax N19.60 billion; basic earnings per share 1,451 kobo (N14.51). Figures are as printed to the nearest N10 million. || NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | income tax row corrected from the issuer's audited statement so that Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 (nine months ended 30 September 2026) added from the unaudited interim filed with NGX (doclib filing library), statement of profit or loss page 3, third of five printed columns (the page prints 3 months 2026, 3 months 2025, 9 months 2026, 9 months 2025 and audited 12 months 2025), N000 scaled to NGN. Printed at the 9 month column: revenue from contracts with customers 116,948,303; cost of sales 57,517,825; gross profit 59,430,478; other income 347,966; other operating gains 633,345; distribution costs 17,083,695 plus administrative expenses 7,911,243 (operating expenses 24,994,938); operating profit 35,416,851; finance income 8,321,818 less finance cost 256,422 (net finance income 8,065,396); profit before taxation 43,482,247; taxation 14,783,964; profit for the period 28,698,283; basic and diluted earnings per share 1,416 kobo, stored as 14.16 naira to match the unit of the EPS row already in this file. Every identity ties exactly: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit; gross profit less operating expenses plus other income and other operating gains equals the printed operating profit; operating profit plus net finance income equals profit before taxation; profit before taxation less taxation equals profit for the period. Net finance costs stores the net finance income as a negative figure, the sign used in every period already in this file. The 152,686,973 printed on this same page is the audited twelve month 2025 column, not a nine month figure. Cross check: the stored H1 2026 revenue of 81,160,000 thousand plus the printed July to September 2026 revenue of 35,789,527 thousand gives 116,949,527 against the printed 116,948,303, a 0.001 percent difference that comes from the H1 figure having been stored rounded to the nearest hundred million naira.
